newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS - ING calls in demand on EOE.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - ING calls in demand on EOE.

text.p: Call options in Dutch bank ING were in strong demand on the European Options Exchange (EOE) on Tuesday, after Goldman Sachs reiterated its Buy on the stock.
By 1355 GMT 6,951 calls had been traded and 1,853 puts, accounting for an unusually high 12.78 percent of total trade.
Goldman put a price of 62.00 guilders on ING within a year. On Tuesday it was trading down 1.00 guilder at 52.70.
Traders said they expected Friday's options expiry to have a negative effect on the market. "Market makers are not fully hedged so we're likely to see lower levels," one trader said.
